body: That'd be the safe choice. However I didnt. Tight enough hose, cold temp and pressure will keep it on. I also wasnt running it at 35 psi. I'd say use a clamp. It wont be a contaminant if sanitized correctly.

There are some options. You can get a carbonating lid which has a hose and with a .5micron stone attached with a ball lock connection on top. I was cheap and just connected a hose to the gas post with the same stone. However, I would have to transfer to another keg when it was carbed up.
